description: Returns a payment link for one of the three ways to keep the book: voices, book, or keepsake, which is the printed hardcover. Stripe shows the price and takes the card and, on the keepsake, the postal address. This tool never takes a card and never names a price. Read the prices from https://choruskeepsake.com/llms.txt when the person asks what it costs.

option.description: voices, book, or keepsake. Only the keepsake is printed and posted.
